title: KKE Cloth and Hair Demo
description: Cloth and hair on Jolt soft bodies with the engine's clipping protection: silk, cotton, denim, wool, leather and satin draped and blowing in the wind, a blanket, sheet and throw piled on a bed, a hammock and a tennis net catching balls, a runner's cape and a curtain, four heads of long, wavy, curly and short hair turning in the wind, and a stress scene that measures what cloth costs.
